import{runDijkstra}from'./Dijkstra';/**
 * Animated Exact TSP using Brute Force
 * Shows each permutation being evaluated
 */export const exactTSPAnimated=(graph,startNode,patients,hospitals)=>{const steps=[];let bestRoute=[];let bestTotalDistance=Infinity;let bestTotalTime=Infinity;// Helper function to generate all permutations
const permute=arr=>{if(arr.length<=1)return[arr];const result=[];for(let i=0;i<arr.length;i++){const current=arr[i];const remaining=arr.slice(0,i).concat(arr.slice(i+1));const remainingPerms=permute(remaining);for(const perm of remainingPerms){result.push([current,...perm]);}}return result;};// Generate all possible patient orderings
const patientPermutations=permute(patients);const totalPermutations=patientPermutations.length;// Initialize with empty best route
steps.push({type:'evaluate',currentRoute:[],currentDistance:0,currentTime:0,bestRoute:[],bestDistance:Infinity,bestTime:Infinity,permutationsChecked:0,totalPermutations,algorithm:'exact'});// For each permutation, calculate the total route cost
for(let i=0;i<patientPermutations.length;i++){const patientOrder=patientPermutations[i];let currentTotalDistance=0;let currentTotalTime=0;let currentLocation=startNode;// Path through patients
for(const patient of patientOrder){const result=runDijkstra(graph,currentLocation,patient);currentTotalDistance+=result.totalDistance;currentTotalTime+=result.totalTime;currentLocation=patient;}// Find best hospital to end at
let bestHospitalDistance=Infinity;let bestHospitalTime=Infinity;let bestHospital=hospitals[0];for(const hospital of hospitals){const result=runDijkstra(graph,currentLocation,hospital);if(result.totalTime<bestHospitalTime){bestHospitalTime=result.totalTime;bestHospitalDistance=result.totalDistance;bestHospital=hospital;}}currentTotalDistance+=bestHospitalDistance;currentTotalTime+=bestHospitalTime;const completeRoute=[startNode,...patientOrder,bestHospital];// Update best route if this is better
if(currentTotalTime<bestTotalTime){bestTotalTime=currentTotalTime;bestTotalDistance=currentTotalDistance;bestRoute=completeRoute;steps.push({type:'update',currentRoute:completeRoute,currentDistance:currentTotalDistance,currentTime:currentTotalTime,bestRoute:[...bestRoute],bestDistance:bestTotalDistance,bestTime:bestTotalTime,permutationsChecked:i+1,totalPermutations,algorithm:'exact'});}else{steps.push({type:'evaluate',currentRoute:completeRoute,currentDistance:currentTotalDistance,currentTime:currentTotalTime,bestRoute:[...bestRoute],bestDistance:bestTotalDistance,bestTime:bestTotalTime,permutationsChecked:i+1,totalPermutations,algorithm:'exact'});}}// Final step
steps.push({type:'complete',currentRoute:bestRoute,currentDistance:bestTotalDistance,currentTime:bestTotalTime,bestRoute:[...bestRoute],bestDistance:bestTotalDistance,bestTime:bestTotalTime,permutationsChecked:totalPermutations,totalPermutations,algorithm:'exact'});return{steps,result:{route:bestRoute,totalDistance:bestTotalDistance,totalTime:bestTotalTime,executionTime:0,nodesExplored:totalPermutations,algorithm:'exact'}};};/**
 * Animated Nearest Neighbor TSP
 * Shows the greedy step-by-step selection
 */export const nearestNeighborTSPAnimated=(graph,startNode,patients,hospitals)=>{const steps=[];const route=[startNode];let totalDistance=0;let totalTime=0;let currentLocation=startNode;const unvisitedPatients=[...patients];const totalSteps=patients.length+1;// patients + hospital selection
// Initialize
steps.push({type:'evaluate',currentRoute:[...route],currentDistance:0,currentTime:0,bestRoute:[...route],bestDistance:0,bestTime:0,permutationsChecked:0,totalPermutations:totalSteps,algorithm:'nearest-neighbor',currentPatient:undefined,remainingPatients:[...unvisitedPatients]});// Visit patients one by one, always choosing the nearest
let stepIndex=0;while(unvisitedPatients.length>0){stepIndex++;let nearestPatient=unvisitedPatients[0];let nearestDistance=Infinity;let nearestTime=Infinity;// Evaluate all remaining patients
for(const patient of unvisitedPatients){const result=runDijkstra(graph,currentLocation,patient);if(result.totalTime<nearestTime){nearestTime=result.totalTime;nearestDistance=result.totalDistance;nearestPatient=patient;}}totalDistance+=nearestDistance;totalTime+=nearestTime;route.push(nearestPatient);currentLocation=nearestPatient;// Remove visited patient
const index=unvisitedPatients.indexOf(nearestPatient);unvisitedPatients.splice(index,1);steps.push({type:'update',currentRoute:[...route],currentDistance:totalDistance,currentTime:totalTime,bestRoute:[...route],bestDistance:totalDistance,bestTime:totalTime,permutationsChecked:stepIndex,totalPermutations:totalSteps,algorithm:'nearest-neighbor',currentPatient:nearestPatient,remainingPatients:[...unvisitedPatients]});}// Find best hospital to end at
stepIndex++;let bestHospital=hospitals[0];let bestHospitalDistance=Infinity;let bestHospitalTime=Infinity;for(const hospital of hospitals){const result=runDijkstra(graph,currentLocation,hospital);if(result.totalTime<bestHospitalTime){bestHospitalTime=result.totalTime;bestHospitalDistance=result.totalDistance;bestHospital=hospital;}}totalDistance+=bestHospitalDistance;totalTime+=bestHospitalTime;route.push(bestHospital);steps.push({type:'complete',currentRoute:[...route],currentDistance:totalDistance,currentTime:totalTime,bestRoute:[...route],bestDistance:totalDistance,bestTime:totalTime,permutationsChecked:stepIndex,totalPermutations:totalSteps,algorithm:'nearest-neighbor',currentPatient:bestHospital,remainingPatients:[]});return{steps,result:{route,totalDistance,totalTime,executionTime:0,nodesExplored:stepIndex,algorithm:'nearest-neighbor'}};};
